questions.issue: 'trabolo' (travesti + bollo, gender-nonconforming/trans-masc-ish queer identity) has no English equivalent; kept as 'trabolos'. 'desalojadas' read as evicted (anti-gentrification).

questions.original: tengo diamantes escondidos en el bocata
questions.issue: 'bocata' (sandwich) is probably a sexual innuendo (hidden diamonds = hidden genitals); rendered literally with sandwich.
'boca-piñata' is a made-up compound (mouth like a piñata, to be hit?); rendered literally.
'ketu mente sena jena' is rhyme filler/near-nonsense, possibly 'que tu mente sea ajena'; left as is in en/eu, would need confirmation.

questions.original: trabolo en tu barrio, mira tú qué crema
questions.issue: 'qué crema' = how cool/neat, also rhymes with 'quema'; rhyme not reproduced in en/eu.

questions.original: {Yo no existo, soy de género desconocido}
questions.issue: Spanish gloss in braces: eu version keeps the Spanish gloss unchanged to preserve the original format; change if a Basque gloss is wanted.

questions.original: junta los supuestos dale a no binario
questions.issue: Unclear: 'junta los supuestos, dale a no binario' - read as 'bring together the assumptions/so-called (categories), hit nonbinary'; could also be an imperative 'dale a' = press play on nonbinary.

questions.original: tu mente yo quiero salir del armario
questions.issue: Ambiguous grammar: 'tu mente yo quiero salir del armario' - either 'I want your mind to come out of the closet' or 'I want to come out of the closet (with) your mind'.

questions.original: aqui llega la disidesde el barrio precario
questions.issue: 'disidesde' is a pun/portmanteau of 'disidencia' + 'desde' (dissidence from); not reproducible, rendered as 'dissidence from'.
